scripts.build: npm run build -w @linepool/contracts && npm run build -w @linepool/api && npm run build -w @linepool/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @linepool/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @linepool/api && npm run typecheck -w @linepool/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @linepool/contracts && npm run test -w @linepool/api && npm run test -w @linepool/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @linepool/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w @linepool/api" "npm run dev -w @linepool/web"
